item.text: {"search_note":"I found no reliable 2024 evidence of direct nepotism in the narrow family sense, or of a documented case where Abiy personally routed pardons/procurement to relatives. The strongest evidence is instead indirect: loyalty-based security appointments, state-asset bargaining, aid diversion, and suppression of critics and journalists. So the right read for 7B.9 is not “proven family cronies,” but “meaningful patronage/clientelism risk, with some technocratic counterexamples.”","evidence":[{"title":"Ethiopia discussing selling 10% stake in Ethio Telecom via stock exchange, Abiy says","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-02-20","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/Ethiopia-discussing-selling-10-stake-in-Ethio-Telecom-via-stock-exchange-Abiy-says-45989643/","summary":"Claim: the government moved a major state asset toward a public stock-exchange sale instead of handling it as a private or factional vehicle.
